title: Meridian Cloud agrees to acquire Vireo Analytics in $1.2 billion cash deal
author: Wire staff
text:
Meridian Cloud has agreed to acquire Vireo Analytics for $1.2 billion in cash, the hyperscale cloud provider said on Thursday, adding a fast-growing observability business to its portfolio of developer tools.

Vireo, founded in 2019, sells software that tracks the performance, cost and reliability of applications and AI workloads running across multiple clouds. It says it has about 2,300 paying customers, many of them companies that run on rival platforms.

Meridian said Vireo would keep supporting other clouds after the deal closes, expected in the first half of 2027 and subject to customary closing conditions. About 900 Vireo employees will join Meridian's developer platform division.

"Customers told us they cannot manage what they cannot see, especially as AI inference costs climb," Tomas Ekberg, president of Meridian Cloud's platform business, said in a statement.
